description: Stackable salvage. Not equipment — a material is never fitted to a frame, it accumulates as a quantity and waits for something to consume it. Crafting, upgrades and trading are all future consumers; the registry exists now so loot authored today does not have to be rewritten when they arrive.

classifiedOptics.name: Classified Optics
classifiedOptics.description: A sensor head with a serial number that is not supposed to exist. Worth more intact than the frame it came out of.

prototypeAlloy.name: Prototype Alloy
prototypeAlloy.description: Plate stock from a production run that was never approved. It does not appear on any parts list, which is precisely why it is worth carrying home.

servoAssembly.name: Servo Assembly
servoAssembly.description: Actuator packs cut out of a wrecked drive train. Common enough that every salvage crew has a crate of them and nobody counts.
